name: Short-duration crypto up/down: maker / supply side (split-sell, merge, rebates, toxicity filter)
seed_category: liquidity provision / market making - short-duration crypto markets
one_line: Be the resting liquidity in 5m/15m/1h/4h up/down markets: mint pairs, sell both legs, merge leftovers, collect 20% rebate share and programme rewards while dodging toxic windows.
scope: Cover the supply side only: split $1 into Up+Down, rest asks summing >$1, instant merge recycling, spot-driven digital fair value against the 60 s Chainlink TWAP settle, cancel logic inside the 50 ms taker delay, toxicity rules (last ~50 s near-the-money, >=5 bp Binance moves), per-market pro-rata rebate maths, alt-coin books as less contested, and why retail bleed (25% profitable in 5-minute contracts) funds it. Quantify orphan-leg adverse selection and one-tick spreads. Boundary: the taker/latency side is short-crypto-latency-taker; settlement-window manipulation history is oracle-input-manipulation (only its defensive implications here); generic reward scoring is maker-reward-pool-farming; TWAP end-window pricing is speculative band.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Short-dated crypto up/down: supply-side split-sell + merge + maker rebates
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Mint Up+Down pairs for $1, sell both as a maker for >$1 combined, merge leftovers, collect rebates and LR; never predict direction.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: SPLIT $1 pUSD into 1 Up + 1 Down, rest asks on both (e.g. 0.52 + 0.50 = $1.02 collected), MERGE unsold pairs back to $1 instantly, and repeat across every 5m/15m/1h window and asset. Makers pay zero fee while takers pay up to 1.75 per 100 shares at 50c (crypto feeRate 0.07); makers share a 20% rebate pool per market plus programme rewards ($1M Crypto TWAP LR through Aug 2026). Individual legs often show total losses; they are inventory cost. A 7-month retail study found every taker price band negative (e.g. buying at 0.65-0.70 won 62.6% vs 69.1% break-even) and concluded the money is made on the supply side.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Taker flow from retail gamblers + fee asymmetry + rebates; merge gives instant inventory recycling.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Structural: the fee/rebate schedule pays makers, and retail demand for 5-minute bets is large and price-insensitive.
raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: Adverse selection: the first leg fills exactly when it is becoming less likely, leaving a naked second leg unless flattened in milliseconds; 50 ms taker delay (since 2026-08-17) shortens makers' reaction window; rebate share is pro-rata so scale players dominate; TWAP settlement changed end-of-window dynamics; regime shifts.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Paper-run split-sell on BTC 15m with real websocket book; count paired vs single-leg fills and the PnL of orphan legs; compare against the rebate/LR actually payable at that share.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Liquidity provision in ultra-short crypto contracts with a toxicity filter (the other side of the retail bleed)
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Be the resting liquidity in 5-/15-minute up/down markets where retail loses fastest, while pulling quotes in the windows that manipulation and latency studies identify as toxic.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: Quote both sides of recurring 5-min/15-min/1h crypto contracts, collecting the 20% rebate pool share plus the spread from a flow that is 75% unprofitable. Fair value comes from a spot-driven digital-option model; quotes are cancelled or widened when (a) the cycle is near-the-money inside the last ~50 seconds, (b) a >=5 bp Binance move has occurred within your reaction time. Inventory self-liquidates every few minutes, so capital turns thousands of times per month.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Contract design manufactures uninformed high-frequency gambling flow; skilled wallets are documented to choose the maker role precisely in high-volume short-duration markets.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Capital efficiency (no lock-up) and a structurally losing counterparty base; the residual risks are now measurable thanks to public ms-level datasets.

evidence.title: Manufacturing Speculation: Contract Design and Trader Performance in Prediction Markets (Lei, Rossi), SSRN via Crossref abstract
evidence.supports: Feb-2024..Mar-2026 Polymarket: share of profitable wallets falls from 60% in monthly contracts to 25% in five-minute contracts; $100 is depleted in 404 days in monthly vs 1.6 days in five-minute contracts.

evidence.title: Settlement Manipulation in Prediction Markets (Dai, Jia, Yu), arXiv
evidence.supports: Near-the-money cycles are ~6% of cycles; essentially all signed manipulative spot flow falls in the final 50 seconds; retail (not passive MMs) bore 93% of losses.

evidence.title: OpenMarket: A Synchronized Polymarket-Binance Dataset (Young), arXiv
evidence.supports: 727M rows, Feb-12..May-15-2026: median Polymarket quote response to >=5 bp Binance moves 347 ms; 91.9% of top-of-book spreads are one tick.

evidence.title: Polymarket changelog
evidence.supports: Crypto taker delay cut from 250 ms to 50 ms (2026-08-17) - the maker's protection window shrank 5x; 5-min markets moved to 60 s Chainlink TWAP (2026-08-14); crypto taker fee rate 0.07 with 20% rebate.

raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: One-tick spreads mean the spread itself is tiny - PnL is rebate + selection; the 50 ms taker delay makes you pickable by colocated takers; TWAP settlement changed the end-of-cycle dynamics after the cited studies; ghost-fill counterparties.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Use the public 1-second L2 crypto up/down datasets (Zenodo 22084115, listed in OpenAlex) plus OpenMarket to simulate quote-and-cancel rules; measure markout at 100 ms / 1 s / settlement by seconds-to-expiry bucket before risking capital.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Maker-side quoting in short-dated crypto markets (rebate + reward capture)
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Be the maker the latency takers pay: quote 5m/15m/4h up/down books off a spot-driven fair value and collect spread, 20% fee rebates and targeted reward pools.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: Fair value is a digital-option price from live spot, time-to-expiry and short-horizon vol, now against a 60 s TWAP settle. The bot posts post-only two-sided quotes, cancels inside the 50 ms taker delay when spot jumps, and merges YES+NO inventory back to pUSD. Income is spread plus a pro-rata share of 20% of all taker fees in that market (per-market competition) plus episodic liquidity rewards. In August 2026 Polymarket added $1M of rewards to TWAP-affected markets ($550k on 5-min, $350k on 15-min, $100k on 4-hour).
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Structural: the fee regime moved the edge from takers to makers; taker delay protects quotes; reward pools are paid per market so thin alt-coin books (SOL/XRP/HYPE/BNB/DOGE) are less contested.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Top-of-book is already one tick wide in BTC, but rebates are shared only among makers in the same market, and new short-dated listings start with few makers.

evidence.title: Maker Rebates Program (official docs)
evidence.supports: Crypto feeRate 0.07, 20% rebated to makers, fee-curve weighted, per-market pools, paid daily in pUSD.

evidence.title: Liquidity Rewards (official docs)
evidence.supports: August crypto TWAP program $1M: 5-min $550k (BTC $300k; SOL/ETH/HYPE/XRP $50k each; BNB/DOGE $25k each), 15-min $350k, 4-hour $100k; quadratic spread scoring sampled every minute.

evidence.title: OpenMarket dataset paper
evidence.supports: Stylized fact: one-tick top-of-book spreads in BTC 15-min markets, i.e. makers are already tight.

raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: Adverse selection from faster takers in the final seconds; settlement-window manipulation historically overturned 'near-certain' sides; reward programs are episodic ('ended'); rebate share shrinks as makers arrive.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Paper-quote one alt-coin 15-min market for a week using the public WS feed; compute would-be fills, markouts at +1 s/+10 s and the rebate share implied by observed taker volume.
